item.title: Sayonara Omarchy
item.description: I was a relatively early adopter of Omarchy over a year ago. When I installed it I was struck by how thoughtful it was in its UI. While not something I would have recommended to my family, I did find it great as a programming environment, with everything a keyboard shortcut away.
